title: SQS listeners and at-least-once delivery
prompt: Why can a Spring SQS consumer process the same message twice?
answer: SQS is at-least-once: acknowledgement mode, visibility timeout, and failures determine redelivery, so handlers must be idempotent and use a dead-letter queue.
